name: The Warded Strongbox
reward: Instant: 3 Gold | Delivered: Gilded Relic (sells for 6G in Town).

name: The Sacred Well
subtitle: Ancient Shrine
flavor: Crystal-clear water pools inside moss-covered flagstones, humming with celestial resonance.

choices.title: Commune with Depths (Gamble)
choices.desc: Reveal top 4 class cards. If any contain Heal or Block, restore 4 HP. Otherwise 0 HP.

name: Forgotten Passage
subtitle: Secret Route
flavor: An overgrown stone archway cuts beneath the mountain spine, bypassing patrolled borders.

choices.title: Bypass Border Toll
choices.desc: Travel directly to an adjacent zone without paying border toll or fighting a border mob.

name: The Dead Scout's Map
subtitle: Relic Discovery
flavor: Clutched in the gauntlet of a fallen surveyor lies a parchment charting hidden monster caches.

choices.title: Take the Map
choices.desc: Held card. Your next combat win grants 1 bonus Level Loot card.

name: The Ruined Watchtower
subtitle: Vantage Point
flavor: From this broken battlement, the valley stretches out, revealing roaming monsters and shifting threats.

choices.title: Survey the Valley
choices.desc: Discard other 3 cards in this zone and deal 3 fresh cards from the zone deck.

name: The Wandering Hermit
subtitle: Enigmatic Mystic
flavor: An ascetic sage sits beside a stone cairn, carving protective bone runes against doom.

choices.title: Purchase Bone Ward
choices.desc: Pay 2 + Zone Level Gold. On your next death, Bag does not lock, no corpse retrieval needed, 1-stage quest decay.

name: The Runic Monolith
subtitle: Arcane Wonder
flavor: Ancient glyphs pulse with crimson light along an obsidian slab, sharpening your martial reflexes.

choices.title: Attune with Monolith
choices.desc: Look into your martial arts and reserve 1 card face-up for your next combat hand.

name: The Abandoned Hearth
subtitle: Sheltered Campsite
flavor: Cold embers lie in an alcove sheltered from wind and beasts. A rest here will knit deep wounds.

choices.title: Make Camp & Rest
choices.desc: Fully restore HP to max in the wilderness without trip decay or returning to Town.

name: The Master's Forge
subtitle: Field Smithing
flavor: A master smith's anvil and roaring bellows sit untended, ready to shape steel without workshop fees.

choices.title: Field Smithing
choices.desc: Craft 1 equipment recipe from materials in Bag with 0 forge fee (or salvage +1 Crag-Iron).

name: The Wandering Peddler
subtitle: Wilderness Merchant
flavor: A heavily laden merchant packs sundries and elixirs, eager to barter far from Town taxes.

choices.title: Sell Materials (1G)
choices.desc: Sell all gathering tokens for 1 Gold each.

name: The Trapper's Cache
subtitle: Hidden Stash
flavor: Concealed beneath hollowed boughs lies an oiled leather pack left behind by an old frontier trapper.

choices.title: Kit A: Elusive Scout
choices.desc: Take 1 Smoke Bomb and 1 Food Ration.

choices.title: Kit B: Seasoned Veteran
choices.desc: Take 1 Level Consumable (Whetstone/Charm) and 1 Food Ration.

name: The Alchemist's Field Alembic
subtitle: Strange Apparatus
flavor: A brass distillation apparatus bubbles gently over a blue spirit flame, distilling rare essences.

choices.title: Distill Field Tincture
choices.desc: Transmute 1 Herb from your bag into 2 Healing Potions.

choices.title: Salvage Scrap Metal
choices.desc: Dismantle parts of the apparatus to obtain 1 Crag-Iron ore.

name: The Monstrous Clutch
ability: NEST RAID: Before combat, take 2 unpreventable DMG to seize the Beast Egg and flee immediately.
reward: Beast Egg (sells 4+ZL Gold / eat +4 HP) + Zone Level Gold.

name: The Courier's Satchel
subtitle: Abandoned Pack
flavor: An embossed leather satchel lies beside the trail, sealed with wax and addressed to the Town magistrate.

choices.title: Pocket Contents Now
choices.desc: Pocket travel stipend immediately for 2 + Zone Level Gold.

choices.title: Deliver Sealed Satchel
choices.desc: Take 1x1 Satchel. Deliver to Town for 4 + Zone Level Gold + 1 Bounty credit.

name: The Arcane Golem
reward: Drops 1 Level Loot Card + 1 + Zone Level Gold.
